english: Let $ABCDEFGH$ be a parallelepiped in which $ABCD$ is a face and $AE$, $BF$, $CG$, $DH$ are edges, where $A=(1,0,2)$, $B=(7,1,2)$, $D=(2,7,1)$ and $E=(2,2,10)$. Then the volume of the tetrahedron $ACFH$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $ABCDEFGH$ एक समान्तर षट्फलक है जिसमें $ABCD$ एक फलक है तथा $AE$, $BF$, $CG$, $DH$ इसकी कोरें हैं, जहाँ $A=(1,0,2)$, $B=(7,1,2)$, $D=(2,7,1)$ तथा $E=(2,2,10)$ हैं। तब चतुष्फलक $ACFH$ का आयतन ______ है।
solution: Volume $=\dfrac{678}{6}=113$ (one third of the parallelepiped's volume $339$)
solution_full: $ABCD$ is a parallelogram, so $C=B+D-A=(8,8,1)$. The edges $BF$ and $DH$ are equal and parallel to $AE$, so $F=B+\overrightarrow{AE}=(8,3,10)$ and $H=D+\overrightarrow{AE}=(3,9,9)$.

Check: $[\overrightarrow{a}+\overrightarrow{b}\ \ \overrightarrow{a}+\overrightarrow{c}\ \ \overrightarrow{b}+\overrightarrow{c}]=-2[\overrightarrow{a}\ \overrightarrow{b}\ \overrightarrow{c}]$, and $[\overrightarrow{a}\ \overrightarrow{b}\ \overrightarrow{c}]=6(56+2)-1(8+1)+0=339$, so the tetrahedron has one third of the parallelepiped's volume: $\dfrac{339}{3}=113$.
originality_note: New: the tetrahedron on four mutually non-adjacent vertices of an oblique parallelepiped given by four vertices, whose volume is one third of the parallelepiped (way 4). Closest known: the regular tetrahedron inside a cube with one third of its volume (a known geometric fact). Different because: the parallelepiped is oblique and given only by four vertices, so the other vertices must be built from the face and edge structure before the volume is found.

concept_use.Questions based on parallelopiped: Vertices C, F, H from the face ABCD and the parallel edges AE, BF, DH; the parallelepiped volume 339 in the check.
concept_use.Questions based on tetrahedron: Volume of tetrahedron ACFH as one sixth of the box product of AC, AF, AH.

stem_review: Read as a student: every vertex, vector and parameter is introduced before use, every condition is stated, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently with sympy, is unique and equals the Answer Plan. The labelling (ABCD a face, AE, BF, CG, DH edges) fixes every vertex uniquely. Changed: no change.
key_step: Locating C, F, H from the parallelepiped structure, then a 3 x 3 box product.
justification: Routine: build three vertices, one determinant, divide by 6 (or use the one-third relation). Several standard steps, no insight; like 2026-P2-Q1 (L2).
